description: This PHP script is a client implementation for interacting with the TestLink API, specifically for reporting test case results with a forced timestamp. It includes functions for preparing data and executing an XML-RPC call to submit test result details.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Used as generic container objects for context and execution data

methods.name: executeTestCase
methods.description: Executes an XML-RPC request to report a test case result to the TestLink server with specified context and execution data.
